program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15, 10, 22),          # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1": (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),         # diff pair L
    "Lp": (0.3, 0.18, 1.0),         # PMOS load / stage-2 PMOS L
    "gmidp": (9, 6, 14),            # PMOS load & stage-2 gm/Id (matched density)
    "Itail": (8e-6, 3e-6, 11e-6),   # preamp tail current
    "I2": (6e-6, 2e-6, 9e-6),       # stage-2 current
    "Lb": (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),          # bias mirror L
    "winv": (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),        # output inverter nfet width [um]
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-14)
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]
    gmb = 12.0

    # bias: ibias -> diode nfet, mirrored to tail and stage-2 sink
    mb = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], It, vds=0.25)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # preamp: NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=1.0)
    # stage 2: PMOS CS, same density as load
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d2", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x1", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # stage 2: x1 falls (vinp up) -> x2 rises
    n.dev("M5", "x2", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "x2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    # inverter chain: x2 up -> x3 down -> vout up
    wn1, wp1 = 0.42, 1.0
    n.M("MI1N", "x3", "x2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn1, 0.15)
    n.M("MI1P", "x3", "x2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp1, 0.15)
    wn2 = p["winv"]; wp2 = 2.5 * wn2
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "x3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn2, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "x3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", wp2, 0.15)

    # first-order delay model
    cpu = 1.5e-15
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout1 = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A1 = gm1 / gout1
    C1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + 1e-15
    tau1 = C1 / gout1
    t1 = 0.69 * tau1
    C2 = m5.cdd + m6.cdd + (wn1 + wp1) * cpu + 1e-15
    t2 = C2 * (vdd / 2) / I2
    C3 = (wn2 + wp2) * cpu + 1e-15
    t3 = C3 * (vdd / 2) / 60e-6
    t4 = (cl + 3e-15) * (vdd / 2) / (wn2 * 150e-6)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3 + t4

    power = vdd * (iref + It + I2)

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd,
        "power": power,
        "polarity_ok": 1,
        "gain_pre_db": db(A1),
    }
